name: How long does subfloor repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does subfloor repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of subfloor repair varies depending on the extent of the damage and the size of the area requiring work. Minor repairs, like replacing a few boards, might take a day or two, while extensive projects involving structural remediation could take several days to a week. Factors like curing time for adhesives or the need to address underlying issues (e.g., plumbing leaks) can also influence the timeline. We aim to minimize disruption while ensuring a thorough repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Subfloor repair can take anywhere from a day for minor issues to several days for extensive damage, depending on the scope.
